basis: FD4 v2 completed but failed the action-pair gate and had many missed/null actions. The current nearest-head-only estimator restarted on every selected-note switch. This version carries a fixed position/TTC history per lane while keeping one neural circuit and one selected cue.

engineering_assumptions: Keep up to one current nearest-head motion history per lane, using only current/past frame positions; reset that lane's history when its nearest position jumps backward by more than one pixel.
Select the global nearest head and feed only its lane set and current TTC estimate to one fly circuit; exact-position ties fan out.
Crop raw screen positions outside the playfield and invert raw position to progress=1-raw_position.
Use visible typed tap/hold head shape and at most four per-lane-reduced current tail positions.
After cue switch, provide 11 blank 1-ms samples for key release/readout rearm while preserving other lanes' visual histories.
Latch cue entry and clip countdown increases within a selected cue (FD2-A8); pair UP with matching DOWN; support at most two holds.
task_free_control: Two overlapping constant-speed cues 200 ms apart: the second lane's TTC state must already be valid at the first cue crossing and remain active after the 11-ms output blank.
pass: Exact chart/hash; task-free per-lane switch control; deterministic full replay; one continuous neural initialization; unchanged weights; all 1,310 objects receive final head/tap judgements; every physical DOWN is released; no key remains held at end. Descriptive score is not optimized.
